tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and poster background. White posters (schedules, how-it-works) use Paper; black statement posts use Night.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, outlines of tags and boxes, and the logo, on ground. 21:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Solid inverted fill: a reversed tag, a full-bleed bar. Always the opposite of ground.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text and logo on band. 21:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: alu-highlight
tokens.usage: Brushed-aluminium plate, light area (sampled from the Opening Act and It's All About Music posters). Same in both themes. Text on it is on-alu (10.6:1).

tokens.name: alu-mid
tokens.usage: Brushed-aluminium plate, mid tone. Same in both themes. Text on it is on-alu (5.3:1).

tokens.name: alu-shadow
tokens.usage: Brushed-aluminium plate, shadow falloff. Same in both themes. Never put text on it: on-alu reaches only 2.8:1.

tokens.name: on-alu
tokens.usage: Text and logo on alu-highlight and alu-mid, in both themes. On metal the ink is always black.

styles.name: poster
styles.usage: One shout per poster. Uppercase, centred or flush to the poster margin.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section heads on posters and pages. Uppercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Slogans inside the slogan box, short stacked statements, footer lines. Uppercase.

styles.name: numerals
styles.usage: Opening hours, dates (02.04), times (19:00). Separate ranges with an em dash and spaces.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Smaller uppercase serif lines under a headline, where Redaction 35 would break up at small sizes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tags, sub-lines (VINYL & FRIENDS, WAKE 'N' BAKE), addresses. Always uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: È un bar in cui la proposta si integra con un'atmosfera musicale strutturata.
styles.usage: Running sentences in sentence case. Bold (700) only for the one fact that matters: servizio all'interno, 6 PX.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Fine print on windows and posters. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between ESCO and the ® mark; tag inner offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag vertical padding; gap between a headline and its sans sub-line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tag horizontal padding; time badge padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Slogan box padding; gap between stacked display lines and their sub-line.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between tags in a row.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space between information blocks (hours, then weekend, then after 22:30).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Poster outer margin at 1080 width (about 7% of the width, as in the posters).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Time badge: square corners, as on the Wake 'n' Bake post.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Tags (ESCO BRILLO / ESCO & BRILLO / ESCO DI CASA). About a fifth of the tag height.

tokens.name: radius-box
tokens.usage: Slogan box (E VADO DA ESCO®, HIGH-QUALITY MUSIC ONLY @ESCO®). About a fifth of the box height.

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: Outline of tags, slogan box and time badge, in ink. Never thicker than the strokes of the sans text inside.
